question: How much notice must an employee with three years of service give when resigning?
reference: Two months of written notice, given to both the manager and the People Team.
reference_contexts: employees who resign must give 1 month of written notice during their first year of service, and 2 months of written notice after their first year.
Notice must be given in writing to both the manager and the People Team.

question: What notice period applies during probation?
reference: During probation either side may end employment with 1 week of notice.
reference_contexts: During probation, either side may end employment with 1 week of notice.

question: How long is the probation period?
reference: The probation period is 6 months.
reference_contexts: The probation period is 6 months.

question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee get?
reference: 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays. Part-time employees get leave pro rata.
reference_contexts: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.
Part-time employees receive annual leave pro rata to their contracted hours.

question: Can I carry unused annual leave over to next year?
reference: Yes, up to 5 unused days can be carried forward, but they must be used by 31 March or they are lost.
reference_contexts: Up to 5 unused days of annual leave may be carried forward to the next year.
Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March; any carried-forward days not used by then are lost.

question: When do I need a medical certificate for sick leave?
reference: A medical certificate is required for any sickness absence longer than 3 consecutive days.
reference_contexts: A medical certificate is required for any sickness absence longer than 3 consecutive days.

question: How long is maternity leave and how much of it is paid?
reference: Maternity leave is 26 weeks: the first 16 weeks at full salary and the remaining 10 weeks unpaid. At least 6 months of continuous service is required for paid leave.
reference_contexts: Maternity leave is 26 weeks. The first 16 weeks are paid at full salary and the remaining 10 weeks are unpaid.
To be eligible for paid maternity or paternity leave, an employee must have at least 6 months of continuous service on the expected date of birth.

question: By when must paternity leave be taken?
reference: Paternity leave (2 weeks at full salary) must be taken within 8 weeks of the child's birth.
reference_contexts: Paternity leave is 2 weeks at full salary. It must be taken within 8 weeks of the child's birth.

question: Can warehouse staff work from home?
reference: No. Remote work is not available to warehouse staff because their duties require them to be on site.
reference_contexts: Remote work is not available to warehouse staff, because their duties require them to be on site.

question: How many days a week can I work remotely, and from when?
reference: Up to 2 days per week, once probation is completed, with the manager's approval.
reference_contexts: Employees may work remotely for up to 2 days per week once they have completed their probation period, with their manager's approval.

question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
reference: Within 30 days of the expense, with the original receipts.
reference_contexts: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the expense, together with the original receipts.

question: What is the hotel limit for a business trip to London?
reference: Up to 200 EUR per night in London (the standard limit elsewhere is 150 EUR).
reference_contexts: Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 150 EUR per night, or up to 200 EUR per night in London and Paris.

question: Can I book premium economy for a 7-hour flight?
reference: Yes. Premium economy is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours; otherwise flights must be economy.
reference_contexts: Flights must be booked in economy class. Premium economy is allowed for flights longer than 6 hours.

question: What happens to my unused holiday when I leave the company?
reference: Unused annual leave, including carried-forward days, is paid out in the final salary.
reference_contexts: Any unused annual leave, including carried-forward days, is paid out in the final salary.

question: By what date do I have to use leave days carried over from last year?
reference: Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March; days not used by then are lost.
reference_contexts: Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March; any carried-forward days not used by then are lost.

question: What are the standard working hours?
reference: 9:00 to 17:30, Monday to Friday: 37.5 hours per week including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break.
reference_contexts: Standard working hours are 9:00 to 17:30, Monday to Friday, which is 37.5 hours per week including a 30-minute unpaid lunch break.

question: Who has to approve an expense claim of 400 EUR?
reference: The head of department, because claims above 250 EUR need their approval.
reference_contexts: Claims above 250 EUR require approval from the head of department.

question: I am still on probation. Can I work from home, and how much notice would I need to give to leave?
reference: Not yet: remote work (up to 2 days per week) is only allowed after probation is completed. During probation, employment can be ended with 1 week of notice.
reference_contexts: Employees may work remotely for up to 2 days per week once they have completed their probation period, with their manager's approval.
During probation, either side may end employment with 1 week of notice.

question: Do agency workers get the 25 days of annual leave described in the handbook?
reference: No. Agency workers are not covered by the handbook (their own contracts apply); the 25 days apply to full-time employees.
reference_contexts: Independent contractors and agency workers are governed by their own contracts and are not covered by this handbook.
Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

question: I am leaving in February and still have carried-forward leave days. Do I lose them?
reference: No. Unused annual leave, including carried-forward days, is paid out in the final salary (normally carried-forward days must be used by 31 March).
reference_contexts: Any unused annual leave, including carried-forward days, is paid out in the final salary.
Carried-forward days must be used by 31 March; any carried-forward days not used by then are lost.

question: How quickly must the service desk respond to a P1 ticket, and what is its resolution target?
reference: First response within 15 minutes; resolution target 4 hours.
reference_contexts: P1 - a whole site or a critical system is down. First response within 15 minutes; resolution target 4 hours.

question: What is the resolution target for a P3 ticket?
reference: 3 business days (first response within 4 hours).
reference_contexts: P3 - one person is affected but has a workaround. First response within 4 hours; resolution target 3 business days.

question: What does error VPN-403 mean and what should I do?
reference: Your account is not in the VPN access group; ask your manager to request VPN access.
reference_contexts: VPN-403: your account is not in the VPN access group. Ask your manager to request VPN access.

question: What should I check if I get error LGN-110?
reference: The MFA code was rejected: check that the date and time on your phone are set automatically.
reference_contexts: LGN-110: the MFA code was rejected. Check that the date and time on your phone are set automatically.

question: What happens if I keep typing the wrong password?
reference: After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
reference_contexts: After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.

question: Someone stole my work laptop. What do I need to do and how quickly?
reference: Report it to the Service Desk within 24 hours; the device is then locked and wiped remotely.
reference_contexts: A lost or stolen laptop or phone must be reported to the Service Desk within 24 hours. The device is then locked and wiped remotely.

question: When are a leaver's accounts disabled, and how long is the mailbox kept?
reference: Accounts are disabled at 18:00 on the last working day; the mailbox is kept for 90 days and then deleted.
reference_contexts: User accounts are disabled at 18:00 on the last working day. The mailbox is kept for 90 days and then deleted.

question: What does Section 7 say about administrator rights?
reference: Standard users do not get administrator rights; developers may receive them with written approval from IT Security.
reference_contexts: Administrator rights are not given to standard users; developers may receive them with written approval from IT Security.

question: My VPN shows error VPN-401. What should I do, and how long must my new password be?
reference: VPN-401 means the password has expired: reset it in the Service Portal and reconnect. The new password must be at least 14 characters long.
reference_contexts: VPN-401: your password has expired. Reset it in the Service Portal, then reconnect.
Passwords must be at least 14 characters long.
